title: QAL
description: QAL is a Lib and Tag mod for other Quim Related mods
body:
**QAL**:  
Minecraft miss out on many useful tags, so I have created this Library for my mods that have some common functions and API's that I need for my work but it also includes some common tags I will be using.

In this example for common tags is Apples, I use these tags all the time in my mods for recipes
and other things I have added the tag for all apples to c:apple

I also do a lot of checks for amour slots that have a given tag, all the tags are in my lib.

In the future I will make a template mod for you to learn from so you might also use my Lib mod.

in the future this will also release any mods I used as 3rd party for people that want my mod to work without the 3rd party mod's extras

**3rd Part**:  
Here are the mods that QAL can replace with limits.  
> [NappyCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/nappycraft) - Main diaper triggers work, has no extra diapres or food, does not support shrink or health, basic functions will work when using QAL over NappyCraft.

**Our Mods Supported**
> [Caregiver](https://modrinth.com/mod/caregiver) - This mod is been worked on so will include QAL support there for not needing [NappyCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/nappycraft) if they stop supporting Add-Ons.

> Friends Joe's Thanksgiving pants Still in the works on but QAL is already able to support it.
